answer: A farm faces 50 separate visits, each one billed $77 at the door for each name it invents, and the bill arrives before the payout. Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. One name, one proof, one entry: Steelbound music copyist harp writ enforces it, and a writ music copyists sign after music office audits is how the check runs. Every zephyr is counted once. One nectar, one entry. The voyage is on the docket.
